title: Zesty Spanish Lentil Bake
description: A hearty, wood-fired Basque-inspired dish featuring lentils, with a rich, winey flavor and crunchy texture, made in accordance with Ayurvedic sattvic principles.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the lentils and enough water to cover them, and soak for 30 minutes.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat, and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the red bell pepper to the skillet, and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red wine to the skillet, and bring to a simmer.
Drain and rinse the lentils, and add them to the skillet, stirring to combine with the vegetable mixture.
Transfer the lentil mixture to a baking dish, and bake for 30 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Remove the dish from the oven, and sprinkle with crushed almonds.
Return the dish to the oven, and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the almonds are toasted.
